== Notes ==
* If being used with [[Life Barrier]], make sure to cast Life Bond '''''after''''' Life Barrier is on the ally (See: [[Order of damage modifiers]]).
** Synergy with [[Balthazar's Spirit]] and [[Seed of Life]] (when cast on the [[bonder]]).
* The redirected damage is [[Damage type#Typeless damage|typeless]].
* The redirected damage does not trigger [[Vengeful Weapon]] or [[Reversal of Damage]].
* This spell does not reduce instances of health sacrifice or loss of health caused by skills such as [[Soul Taker]] or [[Dark Aura]]
